item.title: Judge blocks DHS from acting against a man over a harsh email to an ICE official
item.description: ICE agents turned up at David Streever's home over a harsh email he sent to an ICE official. Now a court order prevents the federal government from making additional threats against him.

item.title: For many Pennsylvania Democrats, frustration with Fetterman is at a breaking point
item.description: A group of former campaign and Senate staffers for John Fetterman say they will soon begin dropping damaging stories about the Pennsylvania Democrat. Many of his constituents are already fed up.

item.title: Trump says developing AI is a critical race, downplaying fears
item.description: President Trump continues to support frontier artificial intelligence development, despite industry fears such technology could destroy humanity, casting AI as a critical race against China.
